content: docgen-action caching is currently broken in Lean 4.29.0: https://github.com/leanprover-community/docgen-action/issues/28
This means that on every commit that lands on main, we'll be waiting an hour or two for a bunch of mathlib stuff to get rebuilt.
I found a workaround that we may want to apply: https://github.com/leanprover-community/docgen-action/issues/28#issuecomment-4253162003
The "Build Project" action for the most recent three commits on main has taken ~170 minutes each time: https://github.com/thefundamentaltheor3m/Sphere-Packing-Lean/commits/main/

Two options are:

  1. live with it until our next Lean upgrade (the bug seems to be not present in Lean v4.30.0-rc2)
  2. apply my workaround: https://github.com/leanprover-community/docgen-action/issues/28#issuecomment-4257085396
